english.title: Fail to give name and address when suspected of breach or attempted breach of railway byelaws
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), when reasonably suspected by **(..SPECIFY NAME OF AUTHORISED PERSON..), an authorised person, of breaching or attempting to breach a railway byelaw failed to give your

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[address]_
(C)_[name and address]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 23(1) and 24(1) of the Railway Byelaws 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
person reasonably suspected by an authorised person
of breaching / attempting to breach the railway byelaws
fail to give name and address when asked by an authorised person

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The authorised person asking for details under byelaw 23(1) shall state the nature of the breach of the byelaws in general terms at the time of the request
